required_corrections.finding: The draft's SOC/Q expressions use exp(log_weight_j) directly. Source computes raw weights, total=wa+wb, then divides both by total. Normalized log weights are checked with finite tolerance, so omitting this final normalization can change exact binary64 center values.
required_corrections.correction: Define old/current normalized linear weights as exp(logw_j)/(exp(logw_0)+exp(logw_1)); use canonical aggregate query means for source-exact centers. SOC center=aggregate.mean[11]; Q center=exp(aggregate.mean[5]). Use the same normalized old weights for forecast.

clarifications.finding: Cursor inconsistency is a valid stop, but equality across all evidence cursors would incorrectly reject valid states. Conditional cursors can differ and bank/conditional cursors may legitimately lag next_index, including all-zero gain/no weight-change events.
clarifications.correction: Specify epoch_begin<=conditional_evidence_cursor_j<=bank_evidence_cursor<=next_index, together with source's has_voltage/joint-evidence flag rules. Equal physical source/index/counts/clock are required across components; equal evidence cursors are not.

clarifications.finding: Ordinary unexcited/unresolved/provisional status transitions are valid. Source aggregate queries leave current_soc and capacity_Ah zero when the point is unavailable, while still computing raw aggregate.mean. Finite-point diagnostics must not score these zero placeholders.
clarifications.correction: Explicitly exempt the three legitimate local-status values/transitions from unexpected-status stops. Read raw centers from aggregate means, attach API availability masks, and never count unavailable raw centers as accurate. At initial/cold entry, identify these values as prior centers rather than learned/currently qualified outputs.
